about: Shared vectors for the widget formula dialect (Task 10.2). The server (api/services/journal_two/widget_formula.py) and the client twin (app/src/pages/journal-2-0/lib/widgetFormula/widgetFormula.js) must reproduce every entry exactly. Read with a file read; never import into a bundle.

conventions.positions: pos and every length count Unicode code points (Python indices; Array.from in JS).
conventions.lengths: every limit counts code points, never UTF-16 units: MAX_LENGTH, MAX_TEXT, NAME_MAX and the 20-character clip of {x}. An astral character (an emoji) counts once.
conventions.trim: field names are trimmed of space (U+0020) and tab ONLY; the whole formula of space, tab and newline. NBSP, U+3000 and other space-like characters are never trimmed (JS String.prototype.trim would trim them: do not use it).
conventions.fold: names match ASCII case-insensitively: only A-Z fold (never toLowerCase).
conventions.floats: numbers compare with abs or relative tolerance 1e-9; a bool never equals a number.
conventions.zero: an expected 0 must be +0: compare with Object.is in JS (Python checks math.copysign). No answer is ever -0.
conventions.significant_digits: a literal has at most 15 significant digits: leading zeros, trailing zeros of the fraction and trailing zeros of a whole number do not count; a literal whose value is not finite is refused as bad_number.
conventions.forbidden_characters: refused anywhere, inside a text or a field name too, as bad_char at their own position: U+0000-0008, U+000B-001F, U+007F-009F, U+00AD, U+061C, U+180E, U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2060-206F, U+D800-DFFF (lone surrogates), U+FEFF, U+FFF9-FFFB, U+E0000-E007F. Tab is allowed; a newline ends a text.
conventions.bad_char_shown: bad_char's {x} is the character itself when it is printable ASCII, U+XXXX when it is invisible (the shown_text list), else its glyph followed by ' (U+XXXX)'.
conventions.null: null is 'no data'. No result is ever NaN or Infinity, and -0 is 0.
conventions.special_floats: a row value {"$float": "nan"|"inf"|"-inf"} decodes to that float.
conventions.build: a build is a list of [text, times] segments, concatenated in order.
conventions.rows: eval_group rows is a rowsets name or an inline list.
conventions.shown_text: {x} is the member's text with whitespace runs collapsed to one space, trimmed, clipped to 20 code points, then each invisible character written as U+XXXX (the fixed list: U+0000-001F, U+007F-009F, U+00A0, U+00AD, U+061C, U+1680, U+180E, U+2000-200F, U+2028-202F, U+205F-206F, U+3000, U+D800-DFFF, U+FEFF, U+FFF9-FFFB, U+E0000-E007F). Whitespace for collapsing is space, tab and newline only.

function_docs.name: If
function_docs.meaning: One value when the condition holds, another when it doesn't.

function_docs.name: Round
function_docs.meaning: Rounded to 0 to 6 decimal places (0 when left out).

function_docs.name: Min
function_docs.meaning: The smallest of the values; empty values are skipped.

function_docs.name: Max
function_docs.meaning: The largest of the values; empty values are skipped.

function_docs.name: CountIf
function_docs.meaning: How many rows meet the condition.

function_docs.name: SumIf
function_docs.meaning: The value added up over the rows that meet the condition, or over all rows.

function_docs.name: AvgIf
function_docs.meaning: The average of the value over the rows that meet the condition, or over all rows.

function_docs.name: Share
function_docs.meaning: The share of rows that meet the condition, from 0 to 1.

function_docs.name: Bucket
function_docs.meaning: Puts a number into ranges: under the first edge, between edges, or the last edge or more.

function_docs.name: Hour
function_docs.meaning: The ET hour, 0 to 23; empty for trades with dates only.

function_docs.name: Weekday
function_docs.meaning: The weekday of a day, Monday to Sunday.
